name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
label: Quest
description: After the hippogryph spirits, Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants the spirit of a faerie dragon next. You are sent west to hunt sprite darters and sprite dragons…
intro: After the hippogryph spirits, Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants the spirit of a faerie dragon next. You are sent west to hunt sprite darters and sprite dragons and capture what makes them strong.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, next I must have you capture a creature that in appearance, may look quite fragile, yet its powerful spirit is what we are truly after. The faerie dragons that I speak of have served the night elves as their allies. We must capture one so that the horde may benefit from this strength of spirit as well.
Here is the muisek, friend. Kill 8 sprite darters or sprite dragons, and capture their muisek. They may be found to the west of here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to capture the muisek of the faerie dragons?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Now the spiritual powers of the faerie dragon will be available to us.
I hope you willing to perform another task for me.
